title: Mashmokh and Tokens
statementMd:
Bimokh is Mashmokh's boss. For the following $*n*$ days he decided to pay to his workers in a new way. At the beginning of each day he will give each worker a certain amount of tokens. Then at the end of each day each worker can give some of his tokens back to get a certain amount of money. The worker can save the rest of tokens but he can't use it in any other day to get more money. If a worker gives back $*w*$ tokens then he'll get ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/99b7c00760a65ea0a7dff81a32dcca47eb28e884.png) dollars.

Mashmokh likes the tokens however he likes money more. That's why he wants to save as many tokens as possible so that the amount of money he gets is maximal possible each day. He has $*n*$ numbers $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$. Number $*x*_{*i*}$ is the number of tokens given to each worker on the $*i*$-th day. Help him calculate for each of $*n*$ days the number of tokens he can save.

## Input

The first line of input contains three space-separated integers $*n*, *a*, *b* (1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}; 1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ 10^{9})$. The second line of input contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*} (1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$.

## Output

Output $*n*$ space-separated integers. The $*i*$-th of them is the number of tokens Mashmokh can save on the $*i*$-th day.
statementZhMd:
Bimokh 是 Mashmokh 的老板。在接下来的 $*n*$ 天里，他决定以一种新的方式向工人支付报酬。每天开始时，他会给每名工人一定数量的代币。然后，在每天结束时，每名工人可以交回一部分代币，以换取一定数量的钱。工人可以保存剩余的代币，但不能在其他任何一天使用这些代币来获得更多的钱。如果一名工人交回 $*w*$ 个代币，那么他将获得 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/99b7c00760a65ea0a7dff81a32dcca47eb28e884.png) 美元。

Mashmokh 喜欢代币，但他更喜欢钱。因此，他希望每天在获得最多钱的前提下，尽可能多地保存代币。他有 $*n*$ 个数 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$。其中，数 $*x*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 天给每名工人的代币数量。请帮助他计算在 $*n*$ 天中的每一天，他能够保存的代币数量。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含三个用空格分隔的整数 $*n*, *a*, *b* (1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}; 1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ 10^{9})$。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个用空格分隔的整数 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$，其中 $1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$。

## 输出格式

输出 $*n*$ 个用空格分隔的整数。第 $*i*$ 个数表示 Mashmokh 在第 $*i*$ 天能够保存的代币数量。
